airline_info.name: Vietnam Airlines
airline_info.description: Vietnam Airlines is the flag carrier of Vietnam, operating domestic and international routes and offering a range of cabin classes and ancillary services such as baggage, meals, seat selection, and travel insurance.

routes.title: Hanoi ↔ Ho Chi Minh City
routes.description: High-frequency domestic route connecting the political and economic centers of Vietnam.

routes.title: Hanoi ↔ Tokyo (NRT/HND)
routes.description: Scheduled international services to major Asian destinations; frequencies vary by route and season.
routes.frequency: daily or several times per week depending on the route

current_promotions.title: Summer 2025 Promotion
current_promotions.description: Up to 30% off selected domestic and Asia routes during the promotion period.
current_promotions.terms: Valid for tickets purchased during the promotion period and completed payment; subject to fare rules.

current_promotions.title: Mileage Bonus for Members
current_promotions.description: Bonus miles awarded to members who register or complete flights during the campaign window.
current_promotions.terms: Membership registration and campaign-specific conditions apply.

ancillary_products.name: Extra Baggage
ancillary_products.description: Purchase additional checked baggage by piece or by kilogram depending on route rules.
ancillary_products.price_note: Price varies by route and weight

ancillary_products.name: Seat Selection
ancillary_products.description: Choose seats in advance (window, aisle, extra legroom). Fees depend on cabin class and seat location.
ancillary_products.price_note: Fees vary by cabin and seat type

ancillary_products.name: Special Meal Requests
ancillary_products.description: Order special meals (vegetarian, religious, child meals) in advance.
ancillary_products.note: Must be requested at least 24–48 hours before departure depending on route

ancillary_products.name: Travel Insurance
ancillary_products.description: Optional travel insurance packages offered via partners.

procedures.name: Online Check-in
procedures.description: Check-in via the airline's website or mobile app prior to departure (typically available 48–24 hours before flight).
steps: Log in with booking reference or e-ticket number
Select seats and obtain mobile or printed boarding pass

procedures.name: Carry-on & Checked Baggage Rules
procedures.description: Size and weight limits for carry-on and checked baggage, with excess baggage fees when limits are exceeded.

details.carry_on: Limits vary by fare class — e.g., 7kg for some fares
details.checked: Allowance varies by fare class; fees apply for excess weight/extra pieces

procedures.name: Visa & Passport Requirements
procedures.description: Passengers must ensure passports are valid and obtain visas if required by the destination country.
procedures.note: Check the destination country's official government resources for entry requirements

procedures.name: Health & Medical Requirements
procedures.description: Information on testing or vaccination requirements if required by the destination at the time of travel.
